title: Demonstration defending strike and protest rights after unionists' conviction
organizer: Part of FGTB mobilizations; CSC delegation present
participants_original: About 150 people, per the Brussels-Ixelles police estimate reported by BX1
threshold_50_evidence: The contemporary report says police estimated about 150 people at this single gathering, above the 50-person threshold.

actual_occurrence.summary: BX1 reports about 150 people demonstrated at midday on Thursday in Brussels.

start_date.summary: Article dated 10 December 2020 says action occurred Thursday, 10 December.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Reported estimate of about 150 at one gathering exceeds 50.

organizer.summary: Action was part of FGTB mobilizations; a CSC delegation attended.

demand.summary: Defended right to strike and demonstrate after unionist convictions; a human-rights league representative called for revision of Belgian Penal Code Article 406.

state_response.summary: No protest-day state response is described; response remains unknown.

notes: The report identifies the demand as defense of Belgian strike/demonstration rights and specifically criticizes use of Belgian Penal Code Article 406. Belga is credited as source; no separate independent contemporary report has yet been opened. ccode=211 is the supplied provisional planning value, not a verified official mapping.
open_questions: Reviewer to examine whether this social mobilization is one event or part of a broader FGTB sequence; do not merge other dates automatically.
Check neighboring-month continuity and any contemporaneous corroboration.

title: La Santé en Lutte demonstration for changes to healthcare financing and working conditions
location: Rue de la Loi, Brussels, between Arts-Loi and Rue Ducale
scope: local public demonstration directed at federal health policy, Belgium
participants_original: About 350 participants, according to the Brussels-Ixelles police estimate reported by BX1
threshold_50_evidence: The report gives a police estimate of about 350 participants at this single gathering, clearly exceeding 50.

actual_occurrence.summary: BX1 reports the demonstration happened Friday evening and about 350 people from La Santé en Lutte attended.

start_date.summary: Article dated 12 December says event happened Friday, 11 December.

location.summary: A specified stretch of Rue de la Loi, opposite the federal government seat.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Reported estimate of about 350 at the single gathering exceeds 50.

demand.summary: Called for a reversal of healthcare policy, structural funding increases and improved work conditions/staffing.

state_response.summary: No authority response to the demonstration is described; all response variables remain unknown.

notes: At least one substantive demand targets Belgian federal healthcare policy; the report states that participants faced the federal government and presented work clothes toward it. The source's Belga credit is for an illustrative photograph only, not proof of story origin. ccode=211 is the supplied provisional planning value, not an official verified mapping.
open_questions: Reviewer to examine field coding, episode status and source adequacy; no independent contemporary corroborating article opened yet.
End date, violence and government response remain unknown.
